policy.claimPolicy: Only at online manual decisions; real quest and achievement domain claims, no shop/ads/season-track/onboarding claims. Claim-ready observations include offline time.

builds.relay: Regular crafting of relay and chip; only relay is equipped. Core capped research policy.
builds.chip: Regular crafting of relay and chip; relay is used until the chip is available, then chip remains equipped. Core capped research policy.
builds.researcher: Same fixed chip preference; after core projects, spend real Data on an accessible affordable expanded research portfolio, repeatables up to level3. No artificial research items.

policy.cadence: 0/1/3 real taps per online second; zero taps still allows manual purchases, crafting, research, rewards and visible drop collection.
policy.sessions: Continuous, two short visits (600+300s), or three five-minute visits (same 900s budget, seed1708). No off-session actions; exact boundaries.
policy.commonPolicy: Existing paid hardware ROI purchases, alternating training, short hardware analysis, relay then chip crafting, first prestige >=3 INT between analyses, same node order. No prepared resources/items/unlocks or free purchases.
policy.precision: Readiness and milestone observations up to10s; manual action timestamps exact; manual decisions every10s and exact returns.
policy.limits: Early two-hour policies, not full late-game loadouts, human retention or week/month balance. Equal seeds cease to have matched RNG streams after actions diverge. Historical no-claim baseline is not a controlled reward-effect comparison.

earnedBuildComparison.scope: Instant same-hardware/equal-account equipment contrast; separate copies only, no changes to controller. Relay burst behavior remains in its actual special-effect quote.
